insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Designed for parents with only girl children; daughter cover up to 25 yrs
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Specific waiting 90 days / 24 months / 36 months for listed conditions; PED 36 months; moratorium 5 years

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent up to 1% of SI/day; ICU up to 2% of SI/day

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care procedures plus 12 Modern Treatments

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Critical Care Benefit: flat 10% of Sum Insured on diagnosis of listed critical illness, in addition to claim

copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-pay if treatment is outside the Area of Coverage (Zone) on the schedule

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: 10% of SI or Rs 50,000 per eye, whichever less
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospital_cash: 0.1% of SI per day, max 1% of SI per any-one-illness

permanent_exclusions: Stem cell implantation other than listed
notable_exclusions_summary: Cover restricted to India. Maternity expenses not covered. Standard IRDAI exclusions plus dental/vision aids and naturopathy.
claim_process_summary: Cashless and reimbursement supported. Helpline 1800-209-1415. Pre-auth within 1 hr of request; final authorisation within 3 hrs of hospital request. Claim form downloadable from newindia.co.in.
